solutionsPortfolio.title: Flagship Business Solutions Portfolio
solutionsPortfolio.description: An indicative list of robust, industry-specific solutions architected by Neudhi23 using Zoho and key strategic partner platforms.

items.description: A modern payment orchestration engine powered by Zoho Payments for rapid onboarding and low-overhead processing.
features: Omnichannel Checkout: Supports UPI, Net Banking, and global Credit/Debit Cards via embedded checkouts, static/dynamic payment links, or direct APIs.
Cost Optimization: Enterprise-grade pricing featuring UPI processing at just 0.5%*.
Financial Intelligence: Native dashboards track real-time transaction health, success/failure metrics, payouts, and settlement balances.

items.description: A headless, microservices-driven digital commerce platform built for high-scale retail operations.
features: Advanced Architecture: Cloud-native, API-first, headless SaaS architecture designed for mobile-first user experience.
B2B & B2C Multi-Tenancy: Single-dashboard management for multi-vendor, multi-store, multi-lingual, and multi-currency global environments.
Robust B2B Capabilities: RFQ pipelines, tiered pricing, bulk order configurations, and customer trade-credit tracking.
Hyperlocal Optimization: Geo-location tracking, automated order routing, and regional language switching.
Operational Backbone: Mass bulk order import/export, granular partial-fulfillment, and automated return/refund workflows.
Enterprise Security: Multi-layered data encryption, secure server boundaries, and strict RBAC.

items.description: A centralized marketing management engine designed specifically for independent brands or multi-client digital marketing agencies using Zoho MarketingPlus.
features: Financial Accountability: Dedicated modules for marketing budget planning, tracking actual spend, and calculating CAC metrics.
Omnichannel Social Desk: Simultaneous connection to over 10 active social media channels for content publishing, review monitoring, and audience interaction.
Campaign Orchestration: Multi-channel journey builders facilitating high-deliverability Email Campaigns, WhatsApp marketing, surveys, and webinar hosting.

items.description: An agile Material Requirements Planning (MRP) system engineered to optimize raw material usage and shop floor efficiency.
features: Demand-Driven Assembly: Production cycles directly triggered by and linked to active Customer Sales Orders.
Advanced Inventory Match Engine: Supports multiple industrial material types, shapes, and sizes
Automated Procurement: Instantly generates and routes Purchase Orders (POs) to approved vendors

items.description: A cost-effective, high-security alternative to legacy suites like Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, powered by Zoho Workplace.
features: Frictionless Data Migration: Comprehensive onboarding support to securely transfer enterprise emails, histories, calendars, and active profiles.
Digital Corporate Ecosystem: Centralized interactive messaging, dynamic internal forums, announcement spaces, polls, surveys, and HD video conferencing.
Secure File Vault (Drive): Corporate document organization utilizing granular folder-level permissions, encryption at rest, and audit trails.
AI Knowledge Assistant: Built-in conversational AI layer allowing employees to query internal drives using natural language.

items.description: An all-in-one planning and monetization engine built on Zoho Backstage to power large-scale enterprise summits, conferences, and virtual events.
features: Production Planning: Unified dashboard for building complex multi-track agendas, session sequences, and speaker profile management.
Sponsor & Exhibitor Hubs: Dedicated portals for corporate sponsors and exhibitors to manage booths, process leads, and maximize brand visibility.
Granular Ticket Engine: Flexible configuration supporting free, paid, or invite-only event tiers, multi-class seating/access models, and private access tokens.
Instant Web & App Footprint: Generates an out-of-the-box responsive event website and a mobile application mapped directly to your custom domain.
Automated Lifecycle Communications: Instantaneous delivery of branded booking confirmations, digital entry tickets, and compliant tax invoices.

items.description: A scalable medical facility management platform bridging administrative excellence with institutional compliance.
features: Patient Lifecycle: Seamless digital registration, automated appointment scheduling, reminders, invoicing, and payments.
Compliant Institutional Payroll: Biometric attendance, shift scheduling, leave policies, and income-tax compliant payroll.
Contract Lifecycle Management: Segregated tracking for in-house doctors and consultant/visiting medical professionals.
Hospital Supply Chain: End-to-end procurement for fixed clinical assets and medical consumables.
Regulatory Readiness: Native support for Indian E-Invoicing mandates and automated GST compliance reporting.

items.description: A comprehensive operational ERP designed to meet the strict transparency, accounting, and compliance demands of Section 8 companies, foundations, and religious institutions.
features: Donation Management: Digital tracking of multi-currency financial donations, physical valuables, and in-kind contributions.
Smart Inventory: Procurement workflows integrated with automated tracking for in-kind donation distributions.
Temple-Specific Workflows: Seva/Puja Desk, Hospitality (Bhakt Niwas), and Hundi Audit.
Workforce & Payroll: Built-in attendance, leave tracking, and payroll processing for administrative and operational staff.

items.description: A secure data repository and portfolio mapping core designed for asset managers and financial advisory firms.
features: Multi-Asset Tracking: Centralized structure for managing Equities, Mutual Funds, Fixed Income, Insurance, AIFs, and PMS.
Regulatory Alignment: Structured architecture designed to remain strictly compliant with AMFI regulations and regional data disclosure norms.
Frictionless Ingestion: Supports automated file uploads for bulk institutional data and intuitive manual web input forms.

items.description: A cloud-telephony connector that transforms your CRM environment into an active omni-channel customer communication center.
features: Native Dialing: Click-to-call functionality directly from any client or lead profile inside the CRM system.
Infrastructure Flexibility: Supports effortless configuration with legacy PBX or modern Cloud PBX networks.
Automated Call Registry: Flawlessly logs all incoming and outgoing communication history against relevant customer profiles.
AI-Assisted Summaries: Background call recording with integrated AI transcription engines that generate summaries and highlight action items.
